question: Find the cost of painting all surfaces of a 10 m long hollow steel pipe whose internal and external diameters measure 15 cm and 17 cm respectively, if the cost of painting 1 cm² of the surface is ₹0.15. [Use π = {22over 7} ]
solution:
**Given :**

 

External diameter = 17 cm

 

Internal diameter = 15 cm

 

Cost of painting = Rs 0.15 per cm²

 

Height of cylinder = 10 m = 1000 cm

 

**Concept Used :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a60375a7f4431377b0a1869aa2229ed64d4db94446f64c1624e64014a51b057.png] 

 

Total Surface Area of a hollow cylinder = 2πh(R + r) + 2π(R² - r²) [where R = External Radius, r = Internal Radius]

 

**Calculation :**

 

External Radius(R) = (17)/(2)

 

⇒ 8.5 cm

 

Internal Radius(r) = (15)/(2)

 

⇒ 7.5 cm

 

Total Surface Area of a hollow cylinder = 2πh(R + r) + 2π(R² - r²)

 

Total Surface area = 2π × 1000 × (8.5 + 7.5) + 2π[ (8.5)² - (7.5)² ]

 

⇒ ((44)/(7)) × 1000 × 16 + (44)/(7) × (16)

 

⇒ ((44)/(7)) × 16 [1000 + 1]

 

⇒ 100672 cm²

 

Total cost of painting the cylinder = 100672 × 0.15

 

⇒ Rs 15100.80

 

**∴ The total cost of painting is Rs. 15100.80**
